item.title: What we've been playing - "I think this has the potential to go the whole hog"
item.description: Hello and welcome back to our regular feature where we write a little about the games we've been playing. This week, I've been failing to be competent at a video game, again, Marie has been trying to please Mama, Victoria passes the time in an airport, and Dom is off on one about Nioh again. Read more

item.title: Apex Legends players have until August to get a Switch 2 if they want to keep playing on a Nintendo system
item.description: Season 29 will be the final season for Apex Legends on Nintendo Switch. Read more

item.title: Dispatch studio apologises if it "looks like it was trying to hide" censored Switch content disclaimer: "lots of lessons learned here"
item.description: Developer AdHoc Studio has issued a statement insisting it was not "trying to hide" a disclaimer about censored content on Switch, but did admit it had inadvertently put the notice in "the absolute worst spot" on the Nintendo eShop. Read more

item.title: Highguard has a new 5v5 mode - but it's only live this weekend
item.description: Wildlight has deployed another update to its live-service hero shooter, Highguard, introducing a 5v5 limited-time mode that will only be available this weekend. Read more

item.title: Phasmophobia's 2026 roadmap confirms 4 events, 3 maps, and that 1.0 release and player character overhaul
item.description: Phasmophobia developer Kinetic Games has shared its 2026 roadmap, complete with hints of four seasonal events, two reworked maps, one completely new location, and a load of "major updates", including the player character overhaul, a Unity 6 update, the Nintendo Switch 2 release, and, of course, that highly-anticipated 1.0 release. Read more

item.title: As Highguard stumbles out the gate after weeks of criticism, are we being too hard on live service games?
item.description: Highguard's launch this week would've probably passed by largely unremarked if it wasn't for its appearance at last year's The Game Awards. Unusually for a game with no prior hype or obvious pedigree, it featured as the show's big "and finally" reveal, immediately subjecting it to intense, and slightly bewildered, scrutiny. item.title: Game companies see share prices plummet following the launch of Google's very limited virtual world generator, Project Genie
item.description: Gaming companies saw share prices plummet this week after Google rolled out Project Genie 3, an AI tool that lets users generate virtual worlds in 60-second bursts from text prompts. Read more

item.title: Ashes of Creation's leadership team quits "in protest" as director accuses board of decisions he could "not ethically agree with or carry out"
item.description: The director and creator of Ashes of Creation, the MMORPG brought to life via the $3.2 million donated by almost 20,000 backers in 2017, has quit "in protest" against decisions his board was making that he could "not ethically agree with or carry out". Read more
